note: Making ten to add: development cases for need K2N-19, 2026-11-27, written from blueprint.json in this folder (rows M1-M6), from the standards (1.OA.C.6; 1.OA.B.3, 1.OA.D.7, 1.OA.A.1 where they serve the strategy). Used for design and tuning; the scoring set is separate, written later by a fresh agent from the blueprint alone, sealed. Never taken from the question set. MT-01 to MT-15 are cases this need serves (8 en-US, 7 zh-CN): expect.numbers are the two addends as the question writes them; expect.fill is the frame a teacher fills (the bigger addend's, the first when equal); expect.moved is how many counters cross to fill it, expect.left the ones left, expect.result the sum. The card always fills the bigger addend's frame (after the 2026-11-27 cold read). MT-16 to MT-22 are near misses that belong to other needs (expect.need names it): this need's component must not be used (forbid names the tentative recipe make_ten). Chinese cases use 凑十, 补成 10, 拆, as Chinese learners say them.
